This is a senior, high ￼ impact global technology leadership role with strong visibility across Technical Operations and Engineering. It acts as the global technical authority for Spray Drying across the Bachem Group, accountable for technology strategy, standards, lifecycle stewardship, and scalable deployment across all sites. By owning the technology globally, this role sets standards and makes decisions while owning the full lifecycle from innovation and design to routine manufacturing, ensuring robust, scalable GMP execution and compliance. This role is created in a build-up phase, offering the opportunity to shape mandate, governance, and operating model. The role also supports operational units through hands-on support during the implementation of the new technology. 
• Your responsibilities: Own and continuously improve the global spray drying technology platform (standards, lifecycle stewardship, performance targets, and capability roadmap). Close interaction with the CAPEX and CMC project teams, with corresponding assumption of responsibility within these teams to implement the technology on time and in line with quality requirements. Accountable for global Spray Drying technology decisions, including process standards, technical risk acceptance, and justified deviations Sets global standards and acts as the escalation point for complex Spray Drying technical issues. Owns the relevant framework, such as the associated documentation. Define and maintain global best practices for spray drying, including process design, scale-up approach, CPP/control strategy principles, cleaning concepts, and qualification/validation readiness. Lead and support technology transfer and industrialization of spray drying processes from development or pilot into GMP manufacturing.
